entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: but|they|experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it
entries.description: But they experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it
entries.subject: But
entries.object: experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it

spans.text: So tesaṁ bhogānaṁ ārakkhādhikaraṇaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti: But they experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it, thinking: ‘kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṁ, na corā hareyyuṁ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṁ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun’ti. ‘How can I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits, consumed by fire, swept away by flood, or taken by unloved heirs?’

entries.task_id: how|can|i prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits
entries.description: How can I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits
entries.subject: How
entries.object: I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits

spans.text: So tesaṁ bhogānaṁ ārakkhādhikaraṇaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedeti: But they experience pain and sadness when they try to protect it, thinking: ‘kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṁ, na corā hareyyuṁ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṁ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun’ti. ‘How can I prevent my wealth from being taken by rulers or bandits, consumed by fire, swept away by flood, or taken by unloved heirs?’

entries.task_id: even though|they|protect it and ward it
entries.description: even though they protect it and ward it
entries.subject: even though

spans.text: And even though they protect it and ward it, rulers or bandits take it, or fire consumes it, or flood sweeps it away, or unloved heirs take it.

entries.description: So socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṁ kandati
entries.subject: So

spans.text: So socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion: ‘yampi me ahosi tampi no natthī’ti. ‘What once was mine is gone.’

entries.description: What once was mine is gone
entries.subject: What once

spans.text: So socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṁ kandati, sammohaṁ āpajjati: They sorrow and wail and lament, beating their breast and falling into confusion: ‘yampi me ahosi tampi no natthī’ti. ‘What once was mine is gone.’

entries.task_id: sensual pleasures|they|don their sword and shield
entries.description: sensual pleasures they don their sword and shield
entries.subject: sensual pleasures

spans.text: Furthermore, for the sake of sensual pleasures they don their sword and shield, fasten their bow and arrows, and plunge into a battle massed on both sides, with arrows and spears flying and swords flashing.
Furthermore, for the sake of sensual pleasures they don their sword and shield, fasten their bow and arrows, and charge wetly plastered bastions, with arrows and spears flying and swords flashing.

entries.task_id: there|they|are struck with arrows and spears
entries.description: There they are struck with arrows and spears
entries.subject: There
entries.object: are struck with arrows and spears

spans.text: There they are struck with arrows and spears, and their heads are chopped off, Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti, maraṇamattampi dukkhaṁ.
There they are struck with arrows and spears, splashed with dung, crushed by a superior force, and their heads are chopped off, Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti, maraṇamattampi dukkhaṁ.

entries.description: sensual pleasures they break into houses
entries.subject: sensual pleasures

spans.text: Furthermore, for the sake of sensual pleasures they break into houses, plunder wealth, steal from isolated buildings, commit highway robbery, and commit adultery.
